description: 2033 is the Year of the Water Ox in the Chinese zodiac, from January 31, 2033 to February 18, 2034. Personality, Lunar New Year dates and numerology.
answer: In Chinese astrology, 2033 is the Year of the Water Ox, a Yin year. It began at Lunar New Year on January 31, 2033 and ended on February 18, 2034, so people born in 2033 before Jan 31 belong to the Water Rat year.

sections.heading: 2033 Lunar New Year: start and end dates
paragraphs: Lunar New Year opened the Water Ox year on January 31, 2033, and the year ran to February 18, 2034. So a birth date of Jan 31, 2033 or later counts as Water Ox, and so do early 2034 birthdays through Feb 18; births in 2033 before Jan 31 still belong to the Water Rat. That moving boundary comes from the lunisolar calendar, in which the new year starts with the second new moon after the winter solstice in most years, so its Gregorian date shifts by up to a month from one year to the next. Look sixty years either side and the pairing repeats: 1973 are Water Ox years too. That Monday new year arrived with the Sun in Aquarius in the Western zodiac.

sections.heading: What the Water Ox is like
paragraphs: A counsellor's patience is the traditional mark of this Ox year. With Earth controlling Water, readings describe calm, steady people who favour gradual, well-reasoned progress. Those born now are often leaned on by friends. Creative outlets, small risks that test their flexibility and knowing when to step back protect their energy. Their advice is usually thoughtful, practical and given without judgement, which makes it easy to accept.

In classical thought, Water belongs to the north and to the deep, resting energy of winter, the season when life gathers strength out of sight. As a year stem, it tends to make an animal more reflective, adaptable and emotionally attuned. People born under a Water stem are often described as clever negotiators, sensitive friends and natural mediators who prefer influence to force. They value understanding and tend to think before they act. The caution traditionally attached to Water is fluidity taken too far: avoiding conflict, keeping too much hidden and losing a clear sense of their own direction.

sections.heading: 2033 in the animal cycle and in numerology
paragraphs: In numerology the digits reduce to 8, associated with ambition, authority and material results, so an 8 year is described in terms of effort and reward. The digits of 2033 add up to 8. The Ox holds the second place among the twelve animals and its fixed element is Earth. Set beside the year's Water stem, earth controls Water, which readings use to describe how settled or stretched the combination feels. The year before was the Water Rat and the year after is the Wood Tiger.

Chinese almanacs name 2033 Gui-Chou, pairing the Water stem Gui with the branch Chou. Both are Yin, as stem and branch always share a polarity, so of the hundred and twenty possible pairings only sixty ever occur, and each one names a single year in every cycle.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac is 2033?
faq.answer: 2033 is the Year of the Water Ox. It started on January 31, 2033 and ended on February 18, 2034.

faq.question: What if I was born in January or February 2033?
faq.answer: Check the date against Jan 31. Born before January 31, 2033, you are a Water Rat; born on or after it, you are a Water Ox.

faq.question: What element is 2033 in the Chinese zodiac?
faq.answer: Water, a Yin year. The Ox's own fixed element is Earth; the year element changes every two years, while the fixed element stays with the animal.

faq.question: What is the traditional Chinese name for 2033?
faq.answer: Gui-Chou. The first part is the heavenly stem, which carries the year's element and polarity; the second is the earthly branch, which carries the animal. Almanacs, calendars and Four Pillars charts identify years this way rather than by animal alone.

faq.question: When is the next Water Ox year?
faq.answer: 2093, sixty years later, when the five elements and twelve animals line up again; the table also has 1973.
